summary: Added sitemap.xml at repo root listing the two public pages ('/' for index.html and '/services.html' for services.html) using the canonical domain https://www.luckynailspadurham.com (derived from the pages' canonical/og:url tags), with optional lastmod dates. Appended a 'Sitemap:' line to robots.txt referencing the sitemap, preserving the file's existing CRLF line endings and leaving the two original lines untouched.
commands_run: python -c "import xml.dom.minidom as m; m.parse('sitemap.xml'); print('XML OK')"

python -c "import xml.etree.ElementTree as ET; ns='{http://www.sitemaps.org/schemas/sitemap/0.9}'; locs=[e.text for e in ET.parse('sitemap.xml').getroot().iter(ns+'loc')]; print(locs); assert len(locs)==2 and all(u.startswith('https://www.luckynailspadurham.com/') for u in locs); print('LOCS OK')"
